title: Enhanced photocatalytic degradation of Congo red by a BiVO4/ZnIn2S4 composite: performance and mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21667-21675
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00765A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinyue Liu, Yixin Zhang, Jiaxing Yu, Ming Li
BiVO4/ZnIn2S4 was synthesized via a hydrothermal method, which enabled rapid decomposing Congo red under visible light, providing a feasible strategy for fabricating high-efficiency photocatalysts in water treatment.
